Before you begin

A few helpful answers.

Do I need to know where I want to go?

No finished itinerary is needed to start an enquiry. Share the places or experiences you are considering, or tell Sarah you are still exploring.

What should I include in my enquiry?

Your name and email, a trip idea, approximate dates, and who is traveling are a useful starting point. A budget range and trip notes are optional.

Does submitting an enquiry book my trip?

No. The enquiry form prepares an email for you to send. It does not make a reservation or take a payment. Discuss available services and booking arrangements with Sarah directly.

Does Sarah charge a planning fee?

Ask Sarah to confirm whether fees apply to your trip and what they cover before you agree to any services. No fee schedule is published here.

Can I ask about Disney, Carnival cruises, or Europe?

Yes, you can share those interests with Sarah. These are themes featured on her existing website. Sarah will need to confirm which planning and booking services are currently available.

Where is Sarah based?

Sarah is based in Iowa and works as an independent travel consultant through Archer Travel. Ask her directly about service availability for your location.

What about cancellations, travel insurance, or booking terms?

Ask Sarah for the policies and supplier terms that apply to your specific trip before booking. Terms can depend on the travel provider and booking arrangements.
